title: European political figures say Anthropic disabling access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 is a "wake-up call" about the risks of depending on the US for AI tech (Nathan Rennolds/Associated Press)
summary: Nathan Rennolds / Associated Press: European political figures say Anthropic disabling access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 is a “wake-up call” about the risks of depending on the US for AI tech — Anthropic said it believed the US government had become aware of a potential means of jailbreaking Fable 5.
